CREATE VIEW V_PLAYER_TEAN AS
SELECT A.PLAYER_NAME, A.POSITION, A.BACK_NO
, B.TEAM_ID, B,TEAM_NAME
FROM PLAYER A, TEAM B
WHERE B.TEAM_ID = A, TEAM_ID;

paragraphs.text:
CREATE VIEW V_PLAYER_TEAN AS
SELECT A.PLAYER_NAME, A.POSITION, A.BACK_NO
, B.TEAM_ID, B,TEAM_NAME
FROM PLAYER A, TEAM B
WHERE B.TEAM_ID = A, TEAM_ID;
